title: Audit repository
interface: class AuditRepository(conn). record(actor, action, entity, entity_id, details: dict) -> dict (details stored as JSON text, returned as dict). list_recent(limit=50) -> list[dict] newest first (id DESC). list_for_entity(entity, entity_id) -> list[dict] newest first. Dict keys: id, at, actor, action, entity, entity_id, details (dict). repositories receive a sqlite3.Connection in the constructor (no default) and call conn.commit() after every write; rows are returned as plain dicts with `is_...`/`active` booleans converted from 0/1

uses.connect/get_db: src/db.py: connect(path) -> sqlite3.Connection (row_factory=sqlite3.Row, schema ensured); get_db() -> current app connection; SCHEMA (tables employees, assets, handovers, assignments, audit_log)
